notes.title: Pixeljam's Upcoming Dino Run 2
notes.notes:
Hello All,

You may or may not know that we made a browser game 15 years ago called [b]Dino Run[/b]. Well, we are finally making a sequel and we have a coming soon page for it now.  Please wishlist it if it interests you:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2590330/Dino_Run_2/

It's a multiplayer prehistoric platformer / runner with a lot of visuals customizations & user-made levels. You can keep up with its development via our [url=https://discord.gg/JM2MMUf]Discord[/url] server and also on [url=https://pixeljam.com/dinorun]pixeljam.com/dinorun[/url].

[i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10209198/f12ea75201dc7c2b9e61c7e12e87ab3e47c9514e.png[/img]

notes.title: FREE GAME OFFER - Cure Your Potential Boredom / Lunacy
notes.notes:
Hello all,

Times are weird, and if you are doing your best to combat boredom or craziness, we'd like to help.  Actually, let's help each other?

We're offering 1 free older game of ours to anyone that wants one, in exchange for helping us out a little (either through a signal boost, wishlist or other means).  All you have to do is fill out this simple form with your email, the game you want and a few other things:

[url=https://forms.gle/UwM82aXE1GChtcYB9]https://forms.gle/UwM82aXE1GChtcYB9[/url]

We also just launched the latest update to Nova Drift, entitled GENESIS.  Please check out the game if you haven't yet: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/858210/Nova_Drift/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/858210/Nova_Drift/[/url]

Stay safe & sane!

[i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i]

notes.title: The PIXELJAM COMPLETE Megabundle + DLC Supporter Packs Are Live
notes.notes:
Hello all,

Yesterday we launched [b]PIXELJAM COMPLETE[/b], a massive collection that brings together 14 years of our creative output in a single bundle.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6883465/52afdd3b33033872257b632aab4595fb34aa93bf.png[/img]

[list]
[*] 20+ games & soundtracks
[*] Prototypes & alphas from projects we never finished
[*] Wallpapers, design sketches, art, gifs, comics, music & more
[/list]

[b]You can find it here: [url=https://pixeljam.itch.io/pixeljam-complete]pixeljam.itch.io/pixeljam-complete[/url][/b]

In tandem with this bundle, we are also rolling out "supporter packs" for each of our games on Steam, that contain sketches, concept art, gifs, wallpapers & soundtracks:

(click each game for its supporter pack)

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159130/Cheap_Golf_SUSAN_Supporter_Pack/]Cheap Golf[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/335170/Potatoman_OST__Supporter_Pack/]Potatoman Seeks The Troof[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/383140/Glorkian_Warrior_OST__Supporter_Pack/]Glorkian Warrior[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/424950/Last_Horizon_OST__Supporter_Pack/]Last Horizon[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/510800/Dino_Run_DX_OST/]Dino Run DX[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159270/Gamma_Bros_OST__Supporter_Pack/]Gamma Bros[/url] (Launches Oct 21)
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1160350/Snowball_OST__Supporter_Pack/]Snowball![/url] (Launches Oct 21)

If you just want the goodies for 1 or 2 of our games, the Steam DLC's are the way to go.  However, each of them are only about 1% of the total contents of the Pixeljam Complete bundle, which is overall a much better value.

Also, if you'd like to help boost our launch signal, [url=https://twitter.com/pixeljamgames/status/1184125853371949056]click here[/url].

Thanks for the ongoing support!

-Miles @ Pixeljam

notes.title: Huge DLC Expansion & Upcoming Mega-Bundle
notes.notes:
Hello all,

We just expanded the DLC to become the "OST & Supporter Pack", and now includes the following items:

1) An expanded Soundtrack including outtakes in the same style as the original OST.  This can be found in Local Files > Extras > OST_ALT

2) Design sketches from the early phases of game dev: Local Files > Extras > Design

3) Artwork of all the major planets, suitable for icons (if you shrink them) or wallpapers : Local Files > Extras > Design

If you own the DLC, it should have already updated for you.  If you don't, it's 50% off this week: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/424950/Last_Horizon_OST__Supporter_Pack/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/424950/Last_Horizon_OST__Supporter_Pack/[/url]

This expansion is in preparation for the the mega-bundle we are preparing to launch next week, called [b]PIXELJAM COMPLETE[/b], which will include every game we've made (over 20!) , some completed but unreleased games, every soundtrack, prototypes & alphas, concept art, design docs, gifs, wallpapers, etc...  over 1800 files spanning our 14 years of making games.  

[b]Sign up for our mailing list at [url=http://bit.ly/pixeljammail]http://bit.ly/pixeljammail[/url] to be notified when it launches![/b]. Also, follow us on Twitter for tons of bundle-related festivities: [url=https://twitter.com/pixeljamgames]https://twitter.com/pixeljamgames[/url].

notes.title: -Pixeljam just launched a crowdfunding campaign to create DINO RUN 2-
notes.notes:
You may not know this, but Pixeljam (makers of Last Horizon) have made a lot of games.  One of them you might recall was called [b]Dino Run[/b].  Well, as of last week, we started a campaign to create the sequel:

http://www.pixeljam.com/dinorun

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10778187/d019111fe502dbfdf5edfcadadbec1dc49f281cd.png[/img]

We're making the game in small stages, and using contributed funds to support the development of each stage. Funders get everything we create during the process: concept art, music, prototypes, experiments, alphas, betas, and eventually the full game.

If this is something that interests you, please consider contributing or [url=https://twitter.com/pixeljamgames/status/932693480572358656]spreading the word[/url].  Every little bit helps!


-Miles @ Pixeljam

notes.title: Major Update Coming This Thursday!
notes.notes:
Hello all,

Just a head's up that we will be adding a new game mode to Last Horizon this Thursday (Feb 22):  ESCAPE!

It's the most challenging flight by far, and has more of an arcade feel to it than the other ones, which are more exploratory and calm.

It will be unlocked for everyone to play, regardless of past progress, although we don't recommend trying it until you've beaten a few previous flights.

We hope you will enjoy it!

-Miles @ Pixeljam

notes.title: Space Relocation, Relocation In Last Horizon
notes.notes:
Last Horizon [official site] reminds me of both Asteroids and a version of Jet Pack I had for the Atari ST many moons ago (see what I did there?) that wasn’t as fast-paced and hectic and irritating as this one. It’s a simple exploration game whereby you’ve left your home planet in search of pastures new and are required to gather resources from foreign worlds. Sounds quite lovely, doesn’t it? Until you realise you must tour the galaxy in the dinkiest of spaceships that’s proportionately equal to a Vauxhall Nova in style, durability, and fuel capacity.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Last Horizon Has Landed!
notes.notes:
We hope everyone enjoys the game.  Some things to note:

-If you bought the game the first 15 minutes it was available, it may not have downloaded correctly.  Restart Steam and then the download should work.

-Soundtrack will be available in a few days.

-More info about the game (including iOS / Android versions) are at [url=www.pixeljam.com/lasthorizon]http://www.pixeljam.com/lasthorizon[/url]

Thanks for playing!

-The Pixeljam Team
